senses.definition: The quality of being pleasant or agreeable, whether in respect to situation, climate, manners, disposition etc.

quotes.text:
"I trust that you are as comfortable as circumstances permit," said Holmes, when the final arrangements were made. "Should I be guilty of a liberty if I lit a cigar and placed it between your lips?"
But all amenities were wasted upon the angry German.

quotes.text: When we got to Sullivan Street Mrs. Ricci was waiting in front with a glare in her eye that made me decide not to stop for any amenities.
